issues.description: PaymentDetails interface stores unencrypted credit card data (cardNumber, CVV) in memory. This violates PCI DSS compliance and exposes sensitive data throughout the application.
issues.suggestion: Never handle raw card data in application code. Migrate to payment tokenization (Stripe, PayPal): Replace full card data with tokens provided by payment processors. Example: `interface PaymentDetails { paymentToken: string; amount: number; }`

issues.description: chargeCard() function receives full credit card details as plain parameters. Even though only last 4 digits are logged, the full card data is exposed in memory throughout the payment flow.
issues.suggestion: Implement token-based payment processing. Remove chargeCard() function and replace with payment gateway API calls using tokens only. Keep card tokenization outside your application.

issues.description: Race condition between payment processing and subscription update. If chargeCard() succeeds but upgradeUserSubscription() fails, money is charged but subscription not granted, creating orphaned payments.
issues.suggestion: Implement database transactions: `BEGIN transaction -> chargeCard -> upgradeUserSubscription -> COMMIT`. If any step fails, roll back entire transaction to maintain consistency.

issues.description: console.error() logs full error objects which may contain sensitive payment gateway responses, database credentials, or connection details in production logs.
issues.suggestion: Replace with structured logging that excludes sensitive data: `logger.error('Payment processing failed', { amount, timestamp, errorCode: error.code })` without exposing error details.

issues.description: Card number validation only checks length (16 characters) but doesn't validate numeric format or use Luhn algorithm. Accepts letters and special characters as valid card numbers.
issues.suggestion: Implement comprehensive card validation: 1) Check format with `/^\d{16}$/`, 2) Validate Luhn checksum, 3) Validate CVV is numeric `/^\d{3,4}$/`, 4) Check expiry date isn't in past.

issues.description: chargeCard() performs sequential database inserts without connection pooling. Each payment creates new connection, causing connection exhaustion under load.
issues.suggestion: Configure database connection pool: `new Pool({ max: 20, min: 5 })`. Reuse connections across requests. Batch operations when possible.

issues.description: hasFeatureAccess() fetches entire subscription record just to check one feature. Inefficient for high-frequency access control checks.
issues.suggestion: Query only needed fields: `SELECT features, valid_until FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = $1 AND valid_until > NOW()`. Add database index on (user_id, valid_until).

issues.description: Generic Error strings ('Invalid payment details', 'Insufficient payment amount') without error codes. Calling code cannot distinguish error types for proper handling.
issues.suggestion: Create custom error classes: `class PaymentError extends Error { constructor(code: string, message: string) }`. Throw `new PaymentError('INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS', 'Amount is too low')`.

issues.description: No logging infrastructure for financial transactions. Missing audit trail, payment events, subscription changes logging.
issues.suggestion: Add structured logging: `logger.info('Payment processed', { userId, amount, transactionId, timestamp })`; Log subscription changes, payment failures with appropriate severity levels.

issues.description: Code duplication: `db.query()` followed by `rows.length === 0` check appears multiple times in hasFeatureAccess() and getUserSubscription().
issues.suggestion: Extract helper function: `async function querySubscription(userId): Promise<SubscriptionRow | null> { const rows = await db.query(...); return rows[0] || null; }`

issues.description: Year parsing uses hardcoded 2000 offset: `new Date(2000 + parseInt(year))`. This fails for cards expiring after 2099.
issues.suggestion: Handle 2-digit year correctly: `const fullYear = parseInt(year) > 50 ? 1900 + parseInt(year) : 2000 + parseInt(year)`

issues.description: JSON.parse() on features field has no error handling. Corrupted data in database causes uncaught exceptions.
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch with validation: `try { const features = JSON.parse(row.features); if (!Array.isArray(features)) throw new Error('Invalid format'); } catch (e) { logger.error(...); return false; }`

issues.description: No idempotency handling for payment retries. If client retries payment request due to network timeout, card gets charged twice.
issues.suggestion: Add idempotency key to processPremiumPayment: `function processPremiumPayment(userId, payment, tier, idempotencyKey)`. Check if payment with this key already processed before charging.

issues.description: No rate limiting on payment endpoint. Malicious user or buggy client can spam payment requests without throttling.
issues.suggestion: Implement rate limiting per user: `const paymentLimiter = new RateLimiter({ windowMs: 60000, maxRequests: 5 }); if (!paymentLimiter.allow(userId)) throw new PaymentError('RATE_LIMIT', ...)`

codeQuality.summary: Critical security and architectural issues found in payment processing module. The code handles sensitive financial data without proper safeguards, lacks transaction management, and has insufficient error handling. Multiple CRITICAL and HIGH severity issues must be resolved before production deployment.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Entry point for all payment processing. No tests for happy path, card decline scenarios, database failures, or transaction rollback. High financial impact.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test successful payment flow: valid payment -> amount validation -> card charge -> subscription upgrade. Verify transaction consistency when database fails after charge.

untestedPaths.location: processPremiumPayment() - Database failure after payment line 51-55
untestedPaths.reasoning: Race condition: payment succeeds but subscription update fails. Need verification of rollback mechanism or manual recovery process. Direct financial impact.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock chargeCard() to succeed, upgradeUserSubscription() to fail. Verify payment is not lost and can be recovered. Assert refund or manual intervention recorded.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Card validation has no tests. Currently only checks length. Allows invalid card formats, non-numeric characters, expired cards.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test Luhn algorithm with valid test cards (Visa 4111111111111111, Mastercard 5500005555555559). Test invalid checksums fail. Verify CVV validation for different card types (3 for Visa/MC, 4 for Amex).

untestedPaths.reasoning: Year 2000 offset assumption fails for future dates. No tests for expired cards, invalid month values, leap year edge cases.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test expired card rejection, card expiring current month (should fail), card expiring next month (should pass), invalid months (0, 13), far future dates (>30 years).

untestedPaths.reasoning: Financial calculations have no tests. No verification of base prices, tax rates, processing fees, or discount logic. Direct revenue impact.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Assert professional tier = $29.99 base. Test tax calculation by region (CA 8.25%, NY 8%, EU VAT 19-20%). Verify processing fee calculation (2.9% + fixed). Test discount code application and stacking rules.

untestedPaths.location: calculateSubscriptionPrice() - Tax and fee calculations line 100-104
untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for precision, rounding errors. With many transactions, small calculation errors compound to significant revenue discrepancies.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Verify total calculated as: (basePrice + tax) - discount + processingFee. Assert results maintain 2 decimal precision. Test that total never negative. Verify tax-exempt regions return 0 tax.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Payment processor integration untested. No tests for charge success, card decline, timeout handling, idempotency, or amount precision.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock payment processor success response. Verify transaction ID returned, receipt URL populated. Test idempotency: same key returns same transaction ID. Test amount in cents conversion (33.39 -> 3339).

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for decline scenarios (insufficient funds, fraud, AVS mismatch). No error classification for caller to handle appropriately.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock declined responses for: insufficient funds, fraud detection, address mismatch, expired card. Verify error code/message propagates correctly. Assert no subscription upgrade occurs for declined payments.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for timeout, processor unavailable, connection errors. No retry strategy. Payment flow breaks on network issues.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock timeout after 30s. Verify retry strategy (should return retryable=true). Test processor unavailable (503). Assert idempotency key prevents duplicate charges on retry.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Database update untested. No tests for successful upgrade, downgrade, concurrent updates, or database errors.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Assert user upgraded from basic to professional. Verify tier changed, features array updated, renewal date set to 1 year from now. Test downgrade scenario with prorated refund calculation.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Two simultaneous upgrade requests could corrupt subscription state. No optimistic locking or version checking.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock two concurrent upgradeUserSubscription calls. First succeeds, second fails with 'version mismatch'. Verify database uses versioning/UPSERT with version check.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Feature access control untested. No verification of tier-based feature matrix, subscription status checking, or expiry validation.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Create feature matrix: basic-storage for all tiers, api-access only for professional+, sso only for enterprise. Test denied access for cancelled/expired subscriptions. Verify grace period handling if implemented.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for expired subscriptions, grace periods, or time-sensitive access control.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test denied access for subscription expired yesterday. Test allowed access for subscription expiring tomorrow. Test grace period: access allowed for N days after expiry if grace period enabled.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Database query untested. No tests for valid retrieval, missing user, database errors, or malformed data.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Assert returns complete subscription object with userId, tier, validUntil, features array. Test null returned for user without subscription. Test error propagation for database connection failure.

untestedPaths.reasoning: JSON.parse() on features field has no error handling. Corrupted database data causes uncaught exception.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock corrupted features JSON (invalid syntax). Verify error caught and logged, null returned instead of throwing. Assert invalid data doesn't crash access control.

testCoverage.summary: CRITICAL: Zero test coverage for all functions. The file contains 190 lines of untested payment processing code with explicit '⚠️ NO TESTS' comments. This represents the highest risk area - critical business logic handling payments, subscriptions, and feature access without any automated test coverage.

refactorings.summary: High-impact refactoring opportunities identified across payment processing, subscription management, and data access layers. Priority focuses on security, separation of concerns, and testability improvements.

recommendations.description: URGENT: Eliminate raw credit card handling. Migrate to payment tokenization (Stripe, PayPal, Square) immediately. Never store or process full card numbers in application code. Use only tokens provided by certified payment processors to maintain PCI DSS compliance and reduce security liability.

Implement database transaction management for payment+subscription workflow. Currently has race condition: payment succeeds but subscription update fails, creating orphaned charges. Use BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK to ensure atomic operations.

Add comprehensive test suite for all 7 functions. Current coverage is 0%. Critical gaps: processPremiumPayment happy path and error scenarios, validatePaymentDetails with Luhn algorithm, chargeCard with processor integration, upgradeUserSubscription transaction handling.

Enhance payment card validation: implement Luhn algorithm for card numbers, validate numeric format only, verify CVV length matches card type (3 for Visa/MC, 4 for Amex). Current validation only checks length.

Replace generic errors and console.error with custom error classes and structured logging. Enable error codes for caller differentiation (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS vs CARD_DECLINED). Ensure logs never expose sensitive payment data or database credentials.

Refactor payment processing with Strategy pattern to support multiple payment providers. Extract database queries into Repository pattern. Move hardcoded pricing/tax into ConfigService. Improves testability and enables future payment provider integration.

Add idempotency key mechanism to prevent duplicate charges on client retries. Implement rate limiting per user (max 5 payment attempts per minute) to prevent brute force and accidental duplicates. Add retry logic for network failures with exponential backoff.

Configure database connection pooling (min: 5, max: 20 connections). Query optimization: add indexes on (user_id, valid_until) for subscription lookups. Avoid N+1 queries: batch operations where possible. Optimize hasFeatureAccess() to query only needed fields.
Replace manual date parsing with date-fns library. Current code has bugs: 2000 offset fails after 2099, leap year handling unclear. Use parseISO, addYears, isBefore for reliability.
Add error handling for JSON.parse() on features field. Implement data validation for all database query results to prevent corruption. Use TypeScript guards to validate subscription data shape.
